default.title: 1 - Ideating
default.description: Generate ideas - Is there a clear problem and a viable solution idea?

default.title: 2 - Planning
default.description: Define direction - Is there a basic roadmap with tasks and time estimates?

default.title: 3 - Building
default.description: Create MVP - Are the main features working without critical crashes?

default.title: 4 - Presenting
default.description: Make it usable - Can someone use or demo the basic interface with guidance?

default.title: 5 - Sharing
default.description: Show to the world - Is it published with clear info and a way to get feedback?

default.title: 6 - Polishing
default.description: Refine - Is the code clean, modular, and the infra/configs stable?

default.title: 7 - Releasing
default.description: Launch as product - Is it ready for public use with support and monetization?
